mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase furosemide levels; both drugs can cause electrolyte abnormalities and ototoxicity, with additive risk at higher doses or in renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium), renal function, and hearing; consider alternative antibiotic if available; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustments based on renal function.
